text: 转账在处理期间可能会显示为待处理，最长一天，因为会由我们的其中一个支付处理商处理。之后，钱才会发去收款人的账户。请也再确认你输入了正确的账户资料。SEPA 转账最长需要两个工作日，SWIFT 转账最长需要五个工作日。
label: transfer_status/pending_transfer
source_text: Transfers may show up as pending for up to one day while they are processed by one of our payment processors. Then, they will depart for the beneficiary accounts. Please also double-check that you have entered the correct account details. SEPA transfers can take up to two business days, and SWIFT transfers can take up to five business days.
